item.title: Quarter of a Million Landmines Removed from Zimbabwe - The HALO Trust has destroyed four mines per person in north-east Zimbabwe
item.description: Countries: Zimbabwe, Afghanistan, Angola, Colombia, Sri Lanka, Syrian Arab Republic, Ukraine, Yemen Source: HALO Trust Harare, Zimbabwe, 19 Nov. The world’s largest landmine clearance charity, the HALO Trust, has reached a significant milestone in Zimbabwe, destroying 250,000 landmines since 2013. Dense belts of landmines, including the highly sensitive R2M2 models, were laid along Zimbabwe’s borders with Mozambique and Zambia during the Liberation War in the 1970s.
